name: Invariant-Residue Discriminator Survival
scope: one declared full/visible Resolution-R boundary comparison inventory
statement: Let at least one declared invariant-residue discriminator r_H induced by the selected hidden witness survive boundary projection so that r_H(B_full^R) != r_H(B_vis^R), and require the comparison morphisms to preserve that declared discriminator.
not_claimed: identity of r_H with density or Lambda_H without an explicit representation map
